gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Lai Wan Road running in a north-westerly direction for about 90 m then in a south-westerly direction for about 150 m and terminating at its junction with Lai King Hill Road as shown coloured red on Drawing No. KH 3759.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點與荔灣道連接，向西北伸展約九十米，然後轉向西南伸展約一五〇米，至與荔景山道連接處終結。其位置在KH 3759號圖則上用紅色標明。

history.submitter_remarks: Gazette ZH 荔景山道; geojson 荔景山路.

remarks: Extend joining existing Lai King Hill Road (prior G.N.112/1975).
